note: Shape checked through a consented on-phone redaction on 2026-10-19. All amounts, merchants, card digits, references, dates and contact numbers below are fictional. Only the HDFCBK-S sender family was verified; operator prefixes are interchangeable test labels. This rule supplies a medium-confidence review candidate, never automatic-save eligibility. The body has no year, so the candidate retains SMS arrival time for explicit review.

cases.name: card UPI debit without a movement verb prefills review
cases.body:
Txn Rs.47.35
On HDFC Bank Card 1234
At FICTIONAL STORE
by UPI 123456789012
On 07-10
Not You?
Call 18000000000/SMS BLOCK CC 1234 to 7300000000

cases.name: card UPI with fictional merchant address and grouped amount
cases.body:
Txn Rs.1,234.50
On HDFC Bank Card 6789
At merchant@examplebank
by UPI 234567890123
On 19-10
Not You?
Call 18000000000/SMS BLOCK CC 6789 to 7300000000
